title: Garlic Bread
description: A yeasty, fluffy Filipino bread featuring smoked paprika, perfect for an adventurous snack or side dish.
instructions: Combine warm water and yeast in a bowl, let it sit for 5 minutes until foamy.
Add flour, sugar, and salt to the bowl, mix until a shaggy dough forms.
Knead the dough for 10 minutes until smooth and elastic.
Place the dough in a greased bowl, cover it with plastic wrap, and let it rise in a warm place for 1 hour.
Punch down the dough, shape it into a long loaf, and place it on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Mix melted butter, smoked paprika, and garlic in a small bowl.
Brush the mixture on top of the loaf.
Bake the loaf for 25 minutes until golden brown.
Remove the loaf from the oven, let it cool for 10 minutes before slicing.
